name: Salama (speaking for San Rafael Age-Friendly)
testimony: Look at transportation for the environmental review, also the number of students that walk elementary through college age through the neighborhood. But one of my biggest concerns goes back to our highlighting the wonderful work that our firefighters do and the fire. As you know, there was a fire there a few years ago. It's a very steep, narrow canyon. Fire spreads fast. It's really like Pacific Palisades. And I think we need to be aware that those roads are not wide enough to really handle a fire response. But the other thing that concerns me is that trees have been cleared and work has been started. We don't necessarily have all the fees paid to do the environmental review. And we're entering our wet and rainy season. And last year we had flooding down Locust Avenue. And the city did some fire mitigation on Gold Hill. And you can just see where the hills are unstable. And so my question is, what do.
